listings.summary: The last new Riverstone home in Quail Run, on a cul-de-sac lot.
listings.description: The last new Riverstone home in Quail Run, on a 0.35-acre cul-de-sac lot. Open main level with a vaulted family room, stone fireplace and LVP floors. The owner's suite is on the main with a soaking tub and tiled shower, plus two more bedrooms on the main and a fourth bedroom with its own bath upstairs. Unfinished daylight basement walks out to the backyard. Front porch, covered back deck, two-car garage, and a neighborhood pool and tennis close to downtown Calhoun and I-75.
